step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify external actor: 'USERS' drawn as a user icon -> UserConsumerWeb.
2. Identify central AWS contact center service: 'CONNECT' -> Connect.
3. Identify customer lookup path: Connect connects to Lambda ('Lambda'), which interacts with an external CRM labeled 'Salesforce' -> ThirdParty.
4. Identify reporting path (top branch): Connect sends data to an S3 bucket ('S3'), which is queried by Amazon Athena ('Athena').
5. Identify audio recording / analysis path (bottom branch): Connect dumps recordings to an S3 bucket ('S3'), which feeds into Amazon Transcribe ('Transcribe') and Amazon Comprehend ('Comprehend') for post-call processing and sentiment analysis.
